propositions: Prevent ticket close when own plan or pinned upstream plan changed during execution without revalidating code freshness or rejecting file changes
CLOSE profile disables code freshness checks but retains signature, reopen, registry, phase compatibility, and configured pin enforcement validation
Plan review close gate executes as a pre-status-check callback inside the existing transaction lock immediately before STATUS append to catch concurrent plan/signature/pin changes

With enforce_plan_material_pins=false, pin drift/missing/malformed remain advisory; unsigned, reopened, stale-registry, material drift, malformed metadata, and phase incompatibility always block close
Unsigned/stale/incompatible reviews fail with exact verdict-prefixed message directing separate review-plan remediation with zero LLM/network calls
Config flag require_plan_review_for_close defaults false; existing close paths remain byte-for-byte equivalent with default disabled
